body: Chunk length unit = UTF-16 code units (telegram_len), chosen over Unicode code points. Primary doc core.telegram.org/constructor/config says message_length_max is "length in utf8 codepoints", folk reports claim UTF-16; UTF-16 count >= code-point count, so the chunk fits under either rule at the cost of fewer emoji per chunk.

Brief answer rule: stop_reason end_turn = answer, tool_use = hidden, any other value (null, stop_sequence, refusal) = answer unless a tool call follows before the next prompt. Rejected strict "end_turn only": subagent transcripts carry null on all but the last record, 238 of 530 subagent files end in a null-stop final text (scratch/planner/survey_stop_reason.out.txt).
Renderer and splitter live in new src/render.rs and src/split.rs with purity.rs scanning every src file (plus a test that no unscanned .rs exists), instead of growing lib.rs to ~550 lines.
prefer_file is chunks.len() > SplitLimits.max_chunks (default 4), chosen over a total-length threshold: the cost that matters is messages against the 20/min group budget of TASK-008.

Tried timing threshold 10x for the 4x-input linearity test: an injected O(n) scan per pushed line measured only ~12x (130ms -> 1.56s), too close to 10x. Linear measured 4.0-4.3x, so the threshold is 8x.

Use UAX #29 extended grapheme boundaries via unicode-segmentation instead of the prototype's bounded 16-scalar joiner heuristic; independent probes split longer combining and ZWJ clusters. Keep UTF-16 sizing as a conservative policy and expose only the splitter entry point plus its result type.

Accept unicode-segmentation 1.13.3 for the hard cut, used only via GraphemeCursor at candidate cut points. Alternative rejected: dependency-free unbounded look-back over a joiner table; it still splits regional-indicator flags after an odd prefix (probe_old: flag_split=true) and Indic/Hangul clusters, and a correct hand rule needs UAX #29 tables.

Tried grapheme_indices over every 4096-unit window: correct but split cost rose from ~4 ms to ~43 ms per 236 KB in debug and the render suite from 0.6 s to 2.6 s. Replaced by a char scan plus GraphemeCursor checks at the chosen cut only.

Keep telegram_len and TELEGRAM_TEXT_LIMIT public (PLAN_V2 made them private). The spec requires the same length definition as the Telegram layer and TASK-014 must cap hub messages at 4096; one exported definition prevents drift. IN_PROGRESS_MARKER stays private as PLAN_V2 said.

Rated compact-summary-as-prompt in brief (isCompactSummary non-meta user record, ~17k chars, 8 real briefs affected) as minor with verdict PASS, not NEEDS_WORK: all TASK_FINAL criteria hold and the service-prefix list was an orchestrator-approved decision; suggested fix is one more SERVICE_PREFIXES entry.

Rated brief hiding of user-typed slash commands (<command-name>/<command-message> records, 43 on this machine) as minor with verdict SHIP, not NEEDS_FIXES: the prefix list is part of orchestrator-approved decision 2 and no acceptance criterion covers it; alternative was to block on reclassifying <command-name> records as prompts.
